name: Reine
bestView: Reinebringen summit: 1,971 stone steps up to the whole fjord in one look. Go at 23:00 in June — the light never dies
bestMonths: June to July for midnight sun, September for aurora without crowds
crowd: The Reinebringen steps queue at midday. Climb early or late; the village empties by 18:00
kid: Easy kayak water, troll-fjord boat trips, and midnight beach runs that kids never forget
priceNote: Cabins with kitchens save a family real money: supermarkets are normal-priced, restaurants are not.

visa.note: Schengen rules — same 90/180 day clock as the rest of the zone.
